chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn al-Hasan, from Amr ibn Sa'id, from Musaddaq ibn Sadaqah, from Ammar al-Sabati, from Abu Abd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
A man should not perform salat (prayer) while there is fire or iron in front of him in the direction of his qiblah.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man; here, the praying person
key_terms.حَدِيدٌ: iron placed in front of the worshipper
key_terms.قِبْلَتِهِ: his qiblah; the direction faced in salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat (prayer) while fire or iron is in front of the worshipper?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning salat (prayer) and what should not be placed in front of the worshipper in the direction of the qiblah. It indicates disapproval of praying while fire or iron is directly before one, reflecting the etiquettes and conditions of proper worship.
